data.text: [00:03.9]Oh, hi, can I talk to you a minute, please?
[00:07.6]I’m a bit busy right now, actually.
[00:09.5]Well, it’s really important because I want to take Friday off. Is that OK?
[00:14.8]As I said, I’m rather busy. If you come back later, I’ll be able to talk to you properly.
[00:19.8]I need to know now, though. I mean, my brother has got tickets for something. And I need to let him know now.
[00:26.3]Well, I really don’t think you’re listening to me. I’m busy now and if it’s really urgent, I will talk to you after my meeting this afternoon … .
[00:35.2]But … I need an answer now …
[00:37.2]No, actually, I’ve changed my mind. I don’t like your attitude. The answer is ‘no’. You can’t take Friday off.
